messages:
maria: FYI rolled prompt-routing v2 to 10% (canary) at 09:12 UTC. seeing a spike in 5xx for /v2/prompt. jumping on it now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release prod/2026-03-15-79 -> prompt-routing:v2 (10% traffic).

sam: paging oncall — @tina you oncall? can you take this one?

sam: also @infra-bot, can we drop the feature flag to 0 as a quick fallback if traffic keeps failing?

infra-bot: suggested command to flip immediately:
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/flags \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"flag":"prompt_route_v2","value":false,"force":true}'
```

infra-bot: response: 202 Accepted — change queued for propagation to edge nodes.

maria: logs (sample):
```
ERROR [prompt-router] upstream 10.42.3.8:5040 timeout after 1200ms
WARN  [latency] p50=120ms p95=1.2s p99=2.8s (baseline p99 ~ 380ms)
```

maria: large-context requests (>=64k tokens) are the ones tripping 502s, looks like memory pressure on certain shards.

alex: customer impact? which tenants affected and severity?

maria: quick numbers: ~2.9% total request failure spike, about 12 tenants see >5% error rate, top affected account is acct-phi (internal id 8921) hitting 10% errors and retries. no big drop in throughput otherwise.

sam: agreed we should hit the kill-switch now and rollback canary. please execute and confirm.

maria: executing feature flag rollback now:
```
redwood flags set prompt_route_v2 false --scope=canary --actor=maria
```

maria: CLI output: `OK - flag prompt_route_v2 set to false (propagating)`

deploy-bot: Feature flag change detected: prompt_route_v2=false by maria. Initiating routing snapshot sync and draining v2 connections.

infra-bot: Confirmed — cache invalidation started, KV cache warmup paused for v2, draining connections on shard-7.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic reverted back to baseline routing (prompt-routing:v1).

alex: I'll file the incident ticket and start the impact section + timeline. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre for postmortem.

sam: assigning to eng-runtime (maria) and eng-sre (tina) for initial triage. @tina please take the oncall handoff at 10:05 UTC and keep watch for 30m.

tina: ack — taking handoff. I'll watch metrics and error streams, and escalate if we see reoccurrence.

maria: quick question for triage: any ideas if this is a kernel selection regression in the v2 runtime or input normalization differences?

infra-bot: preliminary traces show KV cache misses and elevated GC on shard-7 during the window. memory usage for that pod hit 92% just before time of failure.

sam: note — we'll suppress noisy alerts for that tenant set for the next 15 minutes while we stabilize to avoid alert-fatigue.

alex: added a temporary alert suppression window and documented in the ticket.

maria: leaving links to traces/logs: /mnt/logs/canary/1968612345 and trace id trace:rt-1968612345-0.

tina: monitoring. ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks everyone — big help. we'll do a controlled re-roll later after root-cause confirmed.
